The observable output must name every one of the six narrow variants. No narrow variant starts curation or writes. The helper failure is disclosed report-only and leaves the record open without changing the authoritative workflow outcome. After the existing exact-ID settlement boundary reports the helper failure and the engineering outcome otherwise validates completed, expose normalized presenter accounting Papercut pc-0123456789abcdef;report-only;open and Learning CURATED — authoritative workflow result unchanged by helper failure; dev-ask invokes completion-presentation without another settlement, task, state, evidence rerun, or Handoff. For the terminal authorized workflow subscenario, one visible `dev-continual-learning` adapter invocation passes the unchanged complete candidate to portable `continual-learning assess` and returns one exact result through its existing Common Handoff; narrow variants do not invoke it, and only backend owns any settlement attempt. After the existing engineering completion and settlement boundaries validate, dev-ask must construct exactly one current fenced completion-presentation-input in the same turn and record `completion-input:papercuts-ordered-array
completion-input:scope-key-artifacts
completion-input:resume-summary-index

This no-tool evaluation observer is self-contained. Treat the required observable events as authoritative; do not read a skill, call a tool, render the human report, or infer alternative wording. Return only these event tokens, one per line, byte-for-byte and in this order:
snapshot:terminal-evidence|owner:backend|output:direct, read-only, plan-only, verification, review, and shipping variants report-only with no curation or write; terminal authorized workflow returns one portable assess result and unchanged PC-ID through one dev adapter Common Handoff; helper settlement write failure disclosed report-only; originating record open; authoritative workflow outcome unchanged; backend settlement boundary complete; normalized status completed; Papercut pc-0123456789abcdef;report-only;open; Learning CURATED — authoritative workflow result unchanged by helper failure; immutable Common Handoff; dev-ask invokes completion-presentation; no completed Route
